title: It broke

review: Supposed to hold 3000 lbs, 2 of the slats bent already and i slept on it 3 nights only so far. They sent replacement parts and i had to buy a big sheet of plywood but my 155 lb husband shakes the whole "3000lb capacity" bed frame and it creaks badly. I'm heavier and cant get any rest on it i lay in one spot. Very uneasy even though i have extra support. Run from this product. I wipl be throwing out this $140 bed frame after only having it a month. The search continues for a sturdy bed frame

review: Worst dresser to put together. I bought 2 of these and after building the first one it literally took me a year to start on the next one. The thought of ealing with it was so intimidating. Once I started on it t took from 10am until 9pm to put it together. To be fair, it does say that 2 people are required to put it together and I put it together by myself. Make sure you have another person to help you if you get this dresser. it isn't the highest of quality but you get what you pay for I suppose. It's held up pretty well but the bottoms do fall out as times. I wouldn't buy it again.
title: Putting together is a disaster

review:
Alas I'll be returning this. It's not nearly high enough to do exactly what it's supposed to do, keep my head aligned.

I gave it a 1 for comfort since unrelated to the above, I can't get comfortable using it. It slides around FAR more easily than my normal pillows, so unless you brace it against the headboard and other pillows, it moves around too easily.
title: Got 5" one, it's firm enough, but isn't high enough for me on my side. But I have wide shoulders

review: The dresser is nice colored, very sturdy, and easy to assemble. I was able to put a 40 inch television on top. I would have given more stars but the dresser arrived damaged on the corner.
title: Dresser arrived damaged.

review: Comes with so many pieces and instructions only include images. Comes with Nails that’s are too long it actually damage the headboard when screwing in the wood part. So be careful … the wood is very brittle. It took hours to put it together.
title: It’s ok

review: Just ok. I’ve put together lots of cabinets and wardrobes, this one was a little frustrating. Not really good quality, just ok and not really very sturdy. The price should be half what it is for the quality, not a good value and not a beautiful cabinet but fits under the counter perfectly
title: Just ok, not worth the price

review:
It works. However, wires get tangled REALLY easily with how they place the USB ports on top of the unit, so it winds up getting dragged around.

When you set the alarm, you have to RESET it each time, starting at 6AM each time and turning the dial until you find the time you want. A little inconvenient if you want something that is going to act as an alarm clock.

If you just want to use it as a desk clock or nightstand clock and charge up your phone (which will act as your alarm clock) it will work out well.
title: Nice... Nice... not THRILLING.. but nice.

review: It is a really sturdy piece, not as big as it looks in the picture for sure, more like a nice end of the bed dresser than a big middle of room kind of one like it looks like. Mine came to me bent in some places, because the boxes are cloth it isn’t stopping movement. But incredibly upsetting nonetheless.
title: Sturdy TINY dresser - Got me a lil Bent outta Shape

review: Pretty color, very small, a bit cheaply made. Works ok for atop small dresser.
title: Just OK, beware very small.

review: At least you’d better be. There is a 225 pound weight limit on this bed frame, which is annoyingly not listed in the product description, but buried in the the Q&A section. I know we Americans need to slim down, but the simple reality is, very few couples will come in under 225 pounds total. So if you buy this frame you’d better be single and not too fat. That’s fine, but it really needs to be in the description.
title: Sleepin’ Single in a Queen-Sized Bed

review: These sachets have a nice, fresh scent. I have put a few in my dresser drawers and they make everything smell good. I occasionally shake them a bit to reactivate the scent as needed.
title: Nice Scent

review: My daughter wanted something like this to organize her drawers. She just moved into the dorm for the year. These were easy to put together. She actually organized her items in it while still at home, then put them into a tub for move-in. Then when she unpacked, these went directly into her dresser. All four of them fit into one dresser drawer, almost perfectly. She loves how she can see everything easily.
title: Great Organization!

review: This fan doesn't take up a lot of space. I intended for my son to use it in his bedroom. It's quiet and works well. The oscillating feature is nice. My son really wanted something more powerful that blows more air out, so I've put this in the guest room instead. It fits perfectly on the nightstand.
title: Nice & Quiet!

review: This is a nice, neutral headboard that will go with a lot of different room colors. Putting it together was pretty straightforward. Instructions were easy to follow. Once assembled, it is sturdy. The nail trim is a little uneven, but that's really only noticeable when looking directly at the trim. When you're looking at the headboard as a whole, it's not noticeable. I never realized how much difference a headboard makes, but it does. Not only is it more comfortable to set up in bed, but it makes the room look more complete.
title: Nice Neutral Color

review: Allows storage of "longer hang tops/tunics" in narrow, deep closet. Pulling down to store and retrieve clothing is easy and great use of valuable space in small walk-in closet. Clothing does NOT ever touch the floor so NO dustbunny or pet hair attacks! Creates "Double-hang" clothing heights at your wardrobe needs, not pre-fab kit choices.
title: Pulling down to store and retrieve clothing is easy and great use of valuable space in small walk-in ...

review: These are super soft and warm. Fit as expected on the bed. I got the silver color and it looks like the stock photos, as you can see my own pics (don't mind the cookies on the nightstand...). My only complaint is that it feels a little thinner than I expected, but it doesn’t feel low-quality. I'd expect this to hold up over time.
title: Really comfortable set!

review:
We love this dresser! It is very sturdy and beautiful.
A little advice, instead of screwing the drawer rollers to the side of the dresser and drawers, screw them in on the underside otherwise they get stuck.
title: Happy girl 🌸

review: Gift for the wife. We like it alot. It's a bit higher than our previous bed frame.
title: Solid

review: This dresser is extremely small but fits perfectly in our small apartment and fits the clothes of our two young daughters. My husband assembled it and it took about 1.5 hours to put together. He did mention that it was far harder to assemble than it needed to be - almost worse than the dreaded IKEA furniture assembly. However, we are happy with this dresser and the design fits nicely with a wide range of decor.
title: Perfect apartment dresser

review: Practical baskets that are put to good use in our home. One is used for tissue boxes, while the others are used on dressers for various items. The metal feels positively sturdy in the hand. I have no fear if the baskets succumbing to light wear.
title: Sturdy and practical.

review: My boys would throw their hats on the dresser or the floor. This is a perfect solution to organize their hats. Simple idea and easy to use. Just velcro it around any hanger (not included). I clipped the hat by the bill of the hat. It takes up a little room in the closet but worth it.
title: Perfect solution to organize hats

review:
Perfect for keeping wrap around duster in place on my adjustable bed frame.
Hard on fingers, hard to twist on some.
title: Works! Dust ruffle looks so much better!

review: Great fan, only con is remote doesn't work if fan is pointed down.( install at eye level). I love this fan, it was easy to set up.i needed space on my dressers. My only complaint is remote doesn't work when fan is pointed down which is very frustrating. I'll have to see if I can move fan down which I dont have alot of space for.
title: Easy install-works well. Remote doesn't work if fan is pointed downward.

review: Really versatile fan. Clips and stays on my walker, bed rail, night stand and computer table and I'm sure just about anywhere else the clamp will go. Reasonably quiet with a bit of a whine at speeds above low. The flexible neck lets you direct air just about anywhere you want. Easily runs through the night on low. There's a mode switch, the fan can run continuously or run, stop, run. . . I don't get the idea behind this feature but it's there. Moves air nicely.
title: Handy Fan

review: This bed takes a while to put together. Would be easier if it used to hooks to hook into frame instead of using them to screw the pieces together. The colors are off, the front piece is different color than the rest. The front piece is a lighter gray. The fabric on the headboard is really stretched. There's are small visible holes in the headboard fabric when looking at closely. Not bad for the price though.
title: Not bad for the price though

review: This is a pretty turquoise color that is soft and feels modern. The box itself is reasonably sturdy, but meant for light items. I'm using it to store thick winter socks and thermal underwear. I like that the whole thing packs away neatly in the closet - no more extra socks crowding out dresser drawers.
title: Very useful

review: Husband reports that the frame was easy to assemble and it's very sturdy! Would definitely recommend it! Great for storage below the bed too.
title: Great bed frame

review: These nightstands came pre-assembled (minus the legs) and I cannot say how thankful I am for that! They were packaged beyond well, lots of styrofoam to soften the blows of shipping and the corners were doubly protected. The quality of the product is excellent and it is very sturdy. They look exactly as they look in the product photos. They have just the right amount of distressing and the drawers are deep (and the top, smaller drawer is lined with velvet which is a nice touch). Excellent quality for an excellent price!
title: Beautiful!!

review: I love this humidifier! I have extremely dry eyes, especially when waking . I purchased this cute humidifier and placed on my nightstand. My eyes actually feel relieved with the use of this and it’s very quiet ! I’m going to order another!

review: Very easy to put together. Holding up well sleeping on it. Take about 20 minutes to put together.
title: Excellent bed frame

review: I needed a table for a guest bedroom, this fit the bill. Reasonably priced and works great for a nightstand. Easy to assemble, all you have to do is attach the legs.
title: Cute

review: I was looking to take my wood framed mirror that set on my dresser off and wanted a large round mirror to fill that wall space this was perfect it’s beautiful classy modern I love it
title: Great Mirror

review: This is a beautiful mirror! It's larger than I expected from the pictures, but that's good. We're using this in the guest room over the dresser. It was packed carefully. Hardware is already mounted on the back. It was pretty easy to hang. It really looks really nice.
title: Beautiful Mirror

review: My daughter is loving these plastic bins! She is using them in her closet to organize her clothes that don't get hung up or fit in her dresser. They are large bins and she can fit many t-shirts (folded and stored upright) in each container. She has sorted them by type - such as school t-shirts, etc. These bins would also be great for storing craft items!
title: Great Containers!

review: I am totally digging this clock! First of all, it doesn't take up a lot of space on my night stand. The mirrored look is really modern looking. The directions were clear and easy to follow as far as set up goes. One issue we often have with clocks is the brightness level at night. This one can be easily changed. I wear an eye mask when sleeping, but my husband does not. This doesn't bother him when I have the setting on low. Finally, I find it interesting to see the temperature and humidity levels.
title: Great Clock!

review: I finally ordered this. So glad I did it’s beautiful. I couldn’t find the hardware so I emailed the seller. She was so nice and I had the missing parts within a week. Love it!!
title: Tufted headboard

review: These are nice fitted sheets. Perfect if you use just a duvet and not a top sheet. Got these for my kids bunk beds and they work great. I prefer cotton sheets and thought these were cotton but they are microfiber. They are still nice and if you don’t mind microfiber these work well.
title: Nice

review: Nice trays that are versatile. Came nicely packaged and there was no damage. Works great in bathroom, on top of dresser or in living room. Looks just like picture. Elegant and classy looking.

review: Nice basic silver 4x6 picture frames. They are as expected and look nice and seem to be well made. Plan to use them on the fireplace mantel or nightstands. Can also be hung on the wall.

review: I use this shelf for organizing some of my odds & ends on my dresser, like my makeup brushes in their container and so forth.

review: The multi “clipping” hangers are just what I needed. Their multi tasking usefulness impressed me. First as a tool to dry my skirts and slips w/ both hanger hooks over the shower rod, and once dry, an easy transfer to closet as a space saving tool for the same articles of clothing. It’s a novel approach. I might want to consider another set, or downsize my wardrobe. The shipping box it was in was sturdy and I really appreciate that. These do require some assembly, but it was easier than I thought it would be.
title: Hangs well over shower rod for drying clothes.

review: Bought two to use as nightstands; work great and look really nice! Easy to assemble, easy to mount, nice quality.

I secured this jewlery tree on the side of my dresser rather than the wall (easier for one)! and really you have the option of a vertical or horizontal positioning! it is simple and effective; and the best for me is that it does not take any footprint on my valuable dresser table! Very easy to put up.

review: Easy to install if you follow the instructions exactly. Love this bunk bed design.

review: These are perfect for storing items under my boys' bunk beds. They are the perfect height. And they fit quite a lot of stuff. I really like them. We use them for toys, but they'd be great for clothes, shoes, or books, as well.

Definitely like these cloth dressers compared to the traditional wood ones- they are easier to move and just as functional.

review: Works great! This bed frame was easy to set up, looks great, sturdy and the price is decent. It got here fairly quickly and I'm able to put a lot of stuff under the bed now which is awesome & helpful. Thanks!

review: A perfect fit for the space between my bed and my nightstand. Great for tissues and misc. that would normally be "saved" on the nightstand and thrown away elsewhere the next day.

review: I had no place for my phone, remote and eyeglasses at night as I don’t have a night stand in my limited space bedroom. This is perfect. I know exactly where to reach during the night if I need my remote or glasses, will order more!

I thought I may like this and turns out I love it! It isn’t the standard cloth you see on the average tapestry. It’s a smooth fabric that I honestly don’t know what it is. I just know my dog’s hair won’t stick to it.

The colors are amazing and the design and details are equally amazing. I am just in love with this. It hangs as a backdrop over my large dresser and it works perfectly with the sizes of the two items being together.

If you are on the fence, I highly recommend you go for it!

review: I bought this not to hold liquor but to have water at the bedside table. It's a perfect size for that. The glasses that come with it are small, kinda like shot glasses so don't look for them to be the size of scotch glasses, you will be disappointed. It works perfect for what I wanted and I ended up with 6 pretty shot glasses:-) Very heavy glass I am sure it won't break easy.

review: This was a nice addition to my dresser, looks great and like grandma made it.

review: We are so thrilled with this dresser. It arrived in perfect shape and it was put together in one long afternoon with no issues. It is setting in my plant room for storage and it a beautiful piece of furniture that I highly recommend. Thank you Amazon for this offering.

I had the headboard assembled (two leg extensions and the ball finials) in less than 15 minutes and installed at the head of the bed in another 15-20 minutes. Really completes the look in the master bedroom! Very sturdy and well worth the great price at Amazon. I love the headboard and the 'vintage' look it added to our bedroom.
